audit_items.proof_trace: Two independent S256-only gates exist: (1) the authorize endpoint rejects any non-S256 `code_challenge_method` before issuing a code (authorize/route.ts:40-44); (2) `verifyCodeChallenge` unconditionally returns `false` for method ≠ 'S256' (oauth.ts:52-54), so even if the DB-stored method were tampered to 'plain' via a direct POST to the consent Server Action, the token endpoint (token/route.ts:110-121) would still reject the exchange. No code path can produce a valid token with the plain method.
